name: Brooklyn Park (United States)
description: White field charged with the city logo: a green quadrant edged with a navy blue arc, and the words Brooklyn Park in dark blue.
history: Brooklyn Park is a suburban city in Hennepin County, Minnesota. Flags of the World records the flag with the older quadrant logo and notes that a flag with the city's new logo was seen in 2017.

features.role: quadrant logo edged in blue with the words Brooklyn Park
